_about: PLACEHOLDER balance values. No balance numbers exist yet (spec gap); playtests will set them. Every value in this file is a placeholder until this note is removed. run.starting_money: money at the start of a run. factory.build_cost: cost of a new factory. factory.input_bay_capacity: widgets that each input bay of a mixed factory holds; it must be at least each recipe count. factory.production_line_cost: cost of a factory's second line; each later line costs production_line_cost_growth times the one before it. demand: a market's price for a color is its base price in markets.json times its demand. Drift moves demand smoothly between random knots, one knot each drift_period_ms, by up to drift_amplitude (0.3 gives 0.7 to 1.3). Each sold widget adds saturation that takes saturation_ms_per_widget to recover (0 turns saturation off), and saturation_half_widgets recent widgets halve demand. A demand event (demand_events.json) starts a random time from event_interval_min_ms to event_interval_max_ms after the one before it. prism.first_price: price of the first prism of the game; each later prism costs prism.price_growth times the one before it (ADR-0003). first_price * (price_growth - 1) must be at least 1.
